title: Transit Gateway: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: You have twenty V P Cs. Peering every pair means a tangle of connections. A Transit Gateway is the hub that replaces the tangle.

scenes.heading: The train network
scenes.narration: Think of a central station that every line passes through. Transit Gateway is a regional hub in a star shape. Each V P C and each site attaches once to the hub. The gateway has its own route tables, separate from the V P C ones. Different tables let you keep some networks isolated.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three traps. It has its own route tables. Peering isn't transitive. It's regional, so you peer gateways across regions.

items.wrong: It spans regions on its own

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.cta: Try the Courseiva Transit Gateway lab
scenes.narration: So, to recap. It's a hub that replaces many peerings. It has its own route tables. It's regional. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva Transit Gateway lab.
